# Observability and Auditability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that audit, logging, tracing and metric requirements allow full, evidence-based reconstruction of every run.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is a unique run identifier required and propagated as a correlation ID across stages, agents and service calls? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-001; CON IX] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the audited event list cover transitions, decisions, approvals, rejections, retries, failures, rollbacks, compensations, fallbacks, replanning, policy outcomes and terminal outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-002; audit-event.schema.json] [D22] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the required audit fields enumerated and enforced by schema? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-003; audit-event.schema.json] [D22] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are metric formulas specified for success rate, failure rate, retry frequency, rollback and compensation frequency, latency and MTTR? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-006; Plan §7.2, §7.3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Are failure-detected, recovery-start and recovery-complete events defined for each recovery mechanism? [Completeness, Plan §7.3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is demonstration labeling required on every metric output, with fault-injected runs flagged? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-007] [D23] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are shortener operational logs required to exclude secrets and personal data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-009] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is append-only behavior specified, including refusal and auditing of modification attempts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-OBS-004; ADR-008] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is tamper detection (hash chain) documented together with its residual risk (consistent whole-chain rewrite)? [Clarity, ADR-008] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is audit completeness quantified (100% of transitions and decisions) with a verification method? [Measurability, PVT-008; Spec §NFR-AUD-001] [D22] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "reconstruct a run from recorded data alone" specified with what the reconstruction must contain? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §NFR-OBS-001] [D22] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the MTTR population defined, with unrecovered and open failures excluded from the denominator and reported separately? [Clarity, Plan §7.3; ADR-011] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is audit retention quantified, together with deletion behavior? [Measurability, PD-002b; policy-set.v1.yaml AUD-001] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the analytics-write-failure metric specified, including where it is exposed? [Clarity, ADR-019; Human Gate 4 ruling 2] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Is it required that metrics are computed only from recorded events? [Consistency, CON IX; ADR-011] [D23] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Does "requirement identifier" in audit queries mean spec IDs, run-level RQ IDs, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-OBS-005; data-model.md Requirement] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Are standard telemetry exporters (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus) marked as optional backlog items? [Clarity, Plan §14.1 BL-06, BL-07] [Optional]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
